item.title: The Star of India: a 563-carat star sapphire
item.description:
GEM HISTORY: Rutile inclusions create the star in this museum gemstone.
EXIMUTC view: consider the star's definition and symmetry, not only clarity. Request a laboratory report with origin and treatment disclosures.
Source: www.amnh.org https://www.amnh.org/exhibitions/permanent/gems-minerals/star-of-india2
